note: This page is served instead of the requested page. It allows no command and will disappear by itself once the problem is solved.
safe_mode.title: Station in safety lockout
safe_mode.text: The supervisor put this station in safety lockout after repeated failures: the radio is receiving and remote access is cut off. The control page is therefore not served.
safe_mode.what: On the station, in openRemoteTRX Console: look for the cause ({m_diagnostic}, {m_journal}), then {m_clear_safe_mode}.
console_off.title: Web console disabled
console_off.text: openRemoteTRX Console is not open on the network for this station.
console_off.what: To open it: on the station, in openRemoteTRX Console, {m_remote_console} (administrator operator account).
no_account.title: No account on this station
no_account.text: The station is running, but no operator account has been created: the control page cannot be served.
no_account.what: On the station, in openRemoteTRX Console: {m_operators}, then restart the station ({m_stop} then {m_start}).
